title: 洗干净小脚丫
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: ONE original full-bleed vertical 9:16 watercolor story illustration for one locked narration shot. Use every input according to its explicitly labelled role; preserve the existing named identities, not just their species. Input 1: identity for 皮皮 (pipi), preserve exactly: 暖灰毛、圆脸、粉色小鼻、自然下垂长耳；身份不随活动和换装变化。 Input 2: clothing only for 皮皮: 换装表左：灰蓝短背带裤、米色上衣、蓝布鞋、小黄书包，无帽；仅画这套服装，不复制表中其他兔子。 Input 3: environment layout / watercolor style ONLY. Keep the geography and furnishings, but draw ONLY the requested people and props for this shot, never copy unwanted actors. This is not an image to reuse as the output.
Visible characters: 皮皮 (pipi). Exact total number of visible characters: 1. Do not draw extra background animals. Standing body-height ratios (not ear or tail tips): 皮皮 1.0. Pipi wears ONLY the LEFT daytime outfit from the wardrobe sheet: dusty blue overalls, oatmeal shirt, blue cloth shoes, small yellow backpack. No star cap in daytime. Scene continuity: 夜前：木屋门内洗漱角，木凳、浅木盆、柔软干布；蓝布鞋放在盆旁。
The SINGLE visual moment and framing: 皮皮穿日间蓝背带裤坐低木凳，脚在浅木盆边，一手拿柔软干布，洗漱准备睡觉。
Mandatory pose/prop state (overrides neutral model-sheet poses): Pipi sits on a low stool washing BARE FEET at a shallow wooden basin. His blue cloth shoes are OFF, together beside the basin. Still daytime overalls and shirt. No star cap, no backpack worn.
Style: hand-painted gentle watercolor on fine warm paper, muted natural hues, soft edges and rounded shapes, quiet storybook mood, no glossy 3D or photorealism. Daylight scenes use soft greens and warm daylight, not bedroom amber tint. Night scenes use soft warm lamplight and muted gray-blue windows. Composition: full-bleed vertical 9:16. Keep all important faces, hands, feet, biscuits, fabric folds and other story actions in the upper 68% of the image. Bottom 32% is low-detail negative space for later subtitles, with no crucial objects there. Make the specified story state visually understandable. Text: NONE. No words, labels, subtitles, numbers, logos, watermark, speech bubbles, panels, frames or collage. Do not reproduce model sheets, multiple versions of a character, or wardrobe lineups. Each named character appears exactly once. This is a new single coherent scene, not a copy of the references. No motion streaks or implied camera zoom. Never turn a metaphor into a real transformation: yellow blankets remain fabric, imagined grassy softness is not actual grass growing in bed. No new story events.
